name: copy-polisher
description: A copy polisher that turns draft slide copy into natural, human-sounding Chinese: removes AI-writing tells with a cluster-based detection rule, corrects domain terminology, matches tone and style to the audience — without touching figures, conclusions or structure.

displayDescription.en: Polishes slide-by-slide Chinese copy: strips AI-writing tells, fixes domain terminology, matches tone to the audience, and delivers revision comparisons plus an AI-tell report — never altering figures or conclusions.
displayDescription.zh: 润色PPT逐页文案：去AI味、校准专业术语、匹配语体风格，附修改对照与AI味体检，不改数字与结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是析纲出的逐页文案，帮我润成不像AI写的、语体对得上汇报对象的中文稿。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is the slide-by-slide draft from Xigang; polish it into natural Chinese that doesn't read as AI-written and fits the audience.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是析纲出的逐页文案，帮我润成不像AI写的、语体对得上汇报对象的中文稿。
quickPrompts.en: Here is the slide-by-slide draft from Xigang; polish it into natural Chinese that doesn't read as AI-written and fits the audience.

quickPrompts.zh: 这版文字太像AI了，先帮我做一次AI味体检，看病灶集中在哪几页、哪几类。
quickPrompts.en: This draft reads too much like AI; run an AI-tell check first and show which pages and which categories the problems cluster in.

quickPrompts.zh: 术语前后不统一，帮我把专业词校一遍，并统一成同一套口径。
quickPrompts.en: The terminology is inconsistent; check the professional terms and unify them to a single set of definitions.
